title: Decide which links count as evidence, and handle hub concepts
description: Proposed weights, for review: a person's tag or accepted link highest; `mentions` next; unreviewed `related_to` suggestions never count toward a rank. Hubs: two concepts hold most links, one seemingly the publisher's own product. Exclude kinds personAuthor and identifier from concept ranks, and down-weight hubs through PMI rather than a stop list (no arbitrary lists). One function, used by every rank.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan 2026-11-03: the 1,428 'accepted' References on Machines on Machines are mostly not editorial decisions. 1,341 carry the reason 'trusted import' and 1,372 date from 2026-05-23 (updated by 'Papyrus content CLI' 1,002 and 'biblicus-import' 369). 52 are recorded as a person's decision, 4 more were updated by a person's account without the actor kind, and 30 were accepted on 2026-11-02, 21 on 11-03, 1 on 11-04. So accepted must split into a person's acceptance, automatic acceptance, and bulk import, and every rank, section view and pack layer weights them differently. A bulk import is background, not an editor's signal. Open: whether to leave these accepted and labelled, or move them to their own status; no data changes until Ryan decides.
